subject: Critical-path dependency deconflict: MSA/DPA/order-form sprint map
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medalign.com>, Procurement <procure@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Critical-path dependency deconflict: MSA/DPA/order-form sprint map

Tom / MedAlign procurement team — attaching the proposed mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short sprint map that sequences MSA, DPA and Order Form dependencies against your evaluation gates. High level asks: 

- Can you confirm whether Countersign by legal (MedAlign) is a hard dependency before order form signature, or if signature can proceed while legal completes redlines?
- For the DPA: is there any additional data classification or subprocessor review we should include in the timeline?
- We propose the following owners: Redwood legal to own MSA redline consolidation (Karthik), Redwood security to deliver SOC2 evidence (Neha), MedAlign procurement to confirm acceptance gates and final sign-off.

Proposed timing (week-level):
- Week 1: MSA redline exchange (initial redlines in DocuSign)
- Week 2: DPA review + SOC2 evidence packet delivered
- Week 3: Order Form finalization and PO submission

If you can confirm the dependency model (hard block vs parallel work) by EOD Wednesday PST we can lock owners and firm dates.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medalign.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medalign.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Critical-path dependency deconflict: MSA/DPA/order-form sprint map

Soojin — thanks for the clear map. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal is usually comfortable allowing commercial signature (Order Form) to proceed if the MSA redline items are non-blocking commercial terms. However, anything touching data residency, processors or indemnities will require legal sign-off first. So the DPA is effectively a hard dependency if it contains subprocessor clauses or retention language.
- On SOC2: we need the full evidence packet (attestation + control narratives) rather than just the summary. Can you confirm Neha can provide the attestation PDF?
- PO timing: our finance team wants an invoice ready within 48 hours of order form signature.

I've added a couple of inline comments to MAP_v1.xlsx (sheet: 'dependencies') and uploaded a short redline note to the DocuSign link you provided. If Redwood can commit to delivering the SOC2 package and a consolidated MSA redline by Friday, we can target an Order Form signature next Thursday (2026-06-10).

Tom
Director, Procurement — MedAlign Therapeutics
Tom.Alvarez@medalign.com | +1 617-555-2233

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Critical-path dependency deconflict: MSA/DPA/order-form sprint map

Looping in a quick internal sequencing suggestion and owners so we can respond to Tom with concrete dates.

Proposed sequencing (short form):
1) Today (Wed): Redwood legal (me) to consolidate MedAlign redlines into a single tracked MSA and post summary to DocuSign by EOD.
2) Thu: Redwood security (Neha) to upload SOC2 attestation + control narratives (Redwood-SOC2-evidence.pdf) and call out any open controls we cannot evidence immediately. This will determine whether DPA clauses are negotiable or hard blocks.
3) Fri: Final MSA consolidation review with Laura (customer success/input on SOW language) and Soojin to confirm commercial terms.
4) Mon (2026-06-08): Send consolidated MSA + DPA back to MedAlign for final legal review.

If MedAlign confirms DPA is a hard block we will call out the specific clause and propose a short redline (we've allowed for a 48–72 hour legal turn). If not a hard block we will proceed with parallel Order Form signature and note the outstanding legal items in the accompanying email and order notes.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-evidence.pdf (to be uploaded Thu)

Action items for this thread: 
- Neha: can you confirm availability to upload the attestation Thursday morning PST?
- Soojin: if MedAlign is insisting PO processing within 48 hours of signature, we should confirm invoicing owner and billing contact in the OPs team.

Thanks — Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Critical-path dependency deconflict: MSA/DPA/order-form sprint map

Team — quick confirmation from MedAlign procurement/legal: 

- We reviewed the consolidation plan and SOC2 packet looks sufficient for our initial DPA review. Please upload the attestation PDF and control narratives to the shared DocuSign envelope (we accept PDFs only).
- We can proceed with an Order Form signature on 2026-06-10 provided the MSA has no unresolved hard-data clauses. If Redwood flags any hard blocks after Karthik's consolidation, please highlight them in the cover email and we will escalate to our legal director.
- We've assigned Procurement owner (Tom) to handle PO issuance; finance will require an invoicing contact and tax info on the signed order form.

I'll mark this as on-track. Tom will post any redline questions in the DocuSign review thread.

Thanks — Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement | MedAlign Therapeutics
marta.ruiz@medalign.com
